entitlements.title: Plan and entitlements
entitlements.description: Grant a plan without payment (Agency for full access) or set a custom monthly article allowance. Every change is written to the audit log.
entitlements.paidNote: This organization has a paid subscription; the plan can’t be changed here, only an extra article allowance and a note.
entitlements.planHint: Trial: no plan (3 articles a month, 1 site).
entitlements.quotaHint: Leave empty to use the plan’s allowance. 0–1000.
entitlements.quotaInvalid: Enter a whole number between 0 and 1000.
entitlements.expiresHint: Empty means no end date. When it ends, entitlements return to the trial.
entitlements.noteHint: Why it was granted (e.g. pilot customer, partner).
